description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Spike Feeder with haste, that enters the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing both +1/+1 counters from it.
Spike Feeder dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Spike Feeder abilities, causing you to gain four life.
Repeat.
